verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE whose agent can write code across workspaces, and a Figma plugin gives it access to Figma designs. That makes design-to-code plausible, but only via Figma. Nothing shows it turning a sketch, image, or PDF into a working app. missing for 10: explicit image/sketch upload-to-code workflow, PDF design ingestion, documented end-to-end generation of a working app from a design, hands-on corroboration.
